semiconductor_relevance: High — Merck Performance Materials Ltd. provides critical materials and equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, playing a significant role in the wafer processing value chain.
summary: Merck Performance Materials Ltd. is a leading integrated materials solutions provider for the semiconductor industry, offering a broad portfolio of innovation-critical materials, services, and equipment. Their expertise spans the entire wafer processing value chain, focusing on advanced packaging, metrology, and defect inspection to enhance yield and accelerate time-to-market for next-generation chips.
capabilities: Cutting-edge metrology tools for Advanced Packaging
Defect inspection equipment for unpatterned wafers
Materials for high-speed data transmission and advanced computing
Integrated materials solutions for novel microchip architectures
